transition.meaning: Merge requested portal or constituent rows and trust state into the house CA ledger. Empty is valid and still advances the generation outside a dry run. Portal and constituent inventories are accepted only on HomeServer.

root_fingerprint.meaning: Replacement root fingerprint (including null); omitted keeps the stored value. Not type-checked by the merger.

bundle_installed.meaning: Value coerced to a boolean; omission keeps the existing value or starts false.

portals.meaning: Rows merged by a nonempty string fqdn; other members are kept.

constituents.meaning: Rows merged by a nonempty string identity; other members are kept.

dry-run.meaning: Validate the transition and report the next generation without writing the ledger.

primitive.meaning: The certificate operation (state_commit), or error for the stop-level exception arm.

role.meaning: Normalized appliance profile used by the certificate operation.

changed.meaning: Whether the primitive reports a change; some failure paths may report partial effects.

dry_run.meaning: Whether the primitive returned a dry-run receipt; a refusal before planning can report false.

state_generation.meaning: Committed integer generation, or the previous uncoerced ledger value (default 0) on dry run.

client_reinstall_required.meaning: Whether clients must reinstall trust for the reported operation.

next_generation.meaning: Generation the dry run would commit.

plan.meaning: Ordered action names describing the proposed operation.

proof.meaning: Evidence named by the primitive for this outcome.
